Name: More Quality Goods
Author: DraconicArcher
Description:
More Quality Goods is an addition to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23386]Yet Another (Balanced) Quality Goods Mod[/url] which adds quality goods for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22121]Syanide's Owls[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8515]Alpacas[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35890]Floral Wines[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]'s Geese.

Get gold quality goods out when you put gold quality in.
Just like 6480's mod, things are balanced at a 70% upgrade, with configuration to go to 100%

The mods included reflect those in my personal modpack. If you'd like other mods included, message me or 6480 to see if we'll add them.
